blocks.text: The first elected Bangsamoro Parliament held its opening session on Oct. 30. “Now comes the hard part,” President Marcos said in his 11-minute speech. A new coalition, a majority and leaders have been agreed upon, he acknowledged. Members of the new parliament were elected during the much-anticipated but quadruply-postponed first Bangsamoro Parliamentary Elections (BPE). The […]...
